cmd: cd /app && ls && head -3 data.txt && wc -l data.txt && python -c "import mteb; print(mteb.__version__)"
python -c "import mteb; print(mteb.__version__)"; pip show sentence-transformers 2>/dev/null | head -2

cat > /app/retrieve.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
from mteb import Encoders
enc = Encoders.from_pretrained("BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5", revision="7999e1d3359715c523056ef9478215996d62a620")
with open("/app/data.txt") as f:
    docs = [line.rstrip("\n") for line in f]
q = enc.encode(["terminal-bench"], as_pandas=False)
d = enc.encode(docs, as_pandas=False)
q = np.asarray(q); d = np.asarray(d)
q = q / np.linalg.norm(q); d = d / np.linalg.norm(d, axis=1, keepdims=True)
sims = d @ q
order = np.argsort(-sims)
print("top5:", [(docs[i], round(float(sims[i]),6)) for i in order[:5]])
with open("/app/result.txt","w") as f:
    f.write(docs[order[4]] + "\n")
EOF
python /app/retrieve.py
